text:
Maya: Thanks everyone who showed up for the post-all-hands Q&A. Sharing a compact follow-up from the reliability section + RCA link: https://redwood.in/rca/203500. Please ack if you own anything or volunteer.
Jordan: Top ask from leadership: a one-paragraph exec summary + a short ownerable action list. Drop ack and ETA here.
Priya: Exec summary draft: Brief outage caused by KV cache eviction storm under two long-context request shapes. Emergency fallback routing and temporary cache increases reduced user impact; full fix involves a shard rebalance and eviction logic patch. Postmortem and metrics in RCA.
Sam: Adding a tiny timeline for quick reference: 02:58 alert, 03:05 mitigation (fallback), 03:32 partial recovery, 03:55 full recovery. Root cause: eviction threshold mis-triggering under specific request mix.
Mei: I've added infra observations to the RCA: hot-shard amplification + uneven load due to placement. Short-term: cache bump + routing; medium-term: rebalance + eviction bugfix.
Ravi: I'll take the cache-bump automation + guardrails. Plan: infra-config toggle + automated rollback if error rate increases. ETA 4 business days.
Taylor: I'll own customer comms. Plan: short customer-facing note (3 bullets) and an enterprise FAQ. Draft by tomorrow noon.
Maya: Leadership also asked for a concrete SLO-triggered fallback policy (who defines thresholds?).
Priya: I'll propose thresholds and the fallback decision matrix. Need Sam/Mei signals. Draft in 3 business days.
Sam: I'll send the signal spec (metrics + example alerts) by EOD. Also proposing we add a small CI replay test for the two request shapes.
NotifyBot: deploy:infra/cache-toggle 2035000150 started by Ravi  staging toggle in progress.
Jordan: Let's capture action items here (owner + due):
```
- C1: Exec paragraph for leadership (owner: Maya) 1 day
- C2: Cache-bump automation + rollback guardrails (owner: Ravi) 4bd
- C3: SLO-trigger thresholds & fallback matrix (owner: Priya + Sam) 5bd
- C4: Customer comms + enterprise FAQ (owner: Taylor) 1bd
- C5: Shard rebalance RFC + timeline (owner: Mei) next sprint
- C6: CI replay test for repro request shapes (owner: Sam) 2w
```
Mei: I'll open the RFC for rebalance and tag infra-ops today.
Ravi: Ack C2. Quick q: should cache-bump apply only to hot shards or cluster-wide? I prefer targeted hot-shard only.
Priya: Targeted hot-shard only to reduce cost and blast radius.
Taylor: For comms, should we include an anonymized timeline? I think yes, short bullets.
Maya: Yes include a small timeline and the mitigation summary. Keep it customer-friendly.
Sam: I'll attach sample metric graphs to the RCA and link here when ready.
Jordan: Please post progress updates in this thread so I can close actions in the all-hands tracker. If you need extra hands, ping @oncall or #eng-oncall.
Priya: One more: let's add a brief test case to Redwood Optimize to detect regressions in quantized eviction paths. I'll add that to the SLO doc as a checkpoint.
Maya: Great. Thanks all for the quick ownership. I'll collect these into the all-hands action tracker after folks ack.
